parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exactly one order by its internal id; the page then holds that order or nothing.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Saved work view; membership is server-defined.

400.description: Invalid cursor, saved view or page size

get.description: The caller's task and checklist reminders in [from, from + days), sorted by remindAt. Clients schedule LOCAL notifications and replace every pending one whose id is no longer in the feed. Task reminders are included only when the session holds work_orders.claim.

post.description: Exchange account email + password for a bearer token. Same throttles, workspace rules and audit as web sign-in; the token is revocable from the web sessions list.

401.description: Invalid credentials (never reveals whether the email exists)

403.description: Account inactive, no workspace, or not a member of that workspace

409.description: Several workspaces — POST again with one slug as `workspace`

get.description: Who this bearer is: staff, workspace, role and effective permissions.

delete.description: Sign out: revoke this bearer server-side.

post.description: The caller's next directed pick. Closes the caller's finished sessions (staging their totes), then opens or reuses a session on the first eligible order. Calling it claims that order for the caller.

200.description: Next line, or an empty run

get.description: Orders with open picks: `unassigned` (no owner) or `all`.

post.description: End the caller's open session(s) on an order without staging its tote (skip / pass). Picked units stay picked.
Open (or reuse) the caller’s picking session on a chosen order.
Pair a tote to the order of the caller's open session before the first unit leaves its bin.

409.description: Session not active (ended, or not the caller's), or the tote carries another order

post.description: Record a picker note on units of the session.

404.description: An allocation is not on this session (or the session is not the caller's)

rowVersion.description: Display revision: the latest of the order and allocated-unit timestamps. NOT an optimistic-concurrency token — do not use it as an expected row version.

fingerprint.description: Send this back as the expected fingerprint when invoking a command on this record. Digest (scheme outbound-work/v2) of the material state of the whole LOGICAL ORDER SET this record belongs to: warehouse stage, label state, latest ingestion id and row version, shipment, the set membership, and every active allocation with its unit status. A digest issued under a different scheme version is never accepted, so refresh after a server upgrade rather than replaying a stored token.

id.description: Stable notification id: `task:<id>` or `checklist:<itemId>:<YYYY-MM-DD>`. Use it as the local notification identifier.

dueAt.description: When the work is due; null for a task with no deadline.

remindAt.description: When to ring. Always inside the requested window.

workspace.description: Workspace slug; required when the account belongs to more than one workspace.

persistent.description: Sliding one-year session instead of the device idle window.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every /api/v1 call. Store in the platform keychain.

slug.description: Tenant subdomain; the value to send back as `workspace`.

permissions.description: Effective permissions — gate UI verbs on these.

runStartedAt.description: When this picker began the run; progress counts picks since then.

skipOrderIds.description: Orders skipped this run — never fed back.

toteScan.description: Raw scan: H-{id}, numeric id, or an external tote barcode.

allocationIds.description: Units on the line the note is about.

sessionId.description: Open picking session on `order`; null when the run is empty.

toteCode.description: OPEN tote already paired to the order — arm it without a scan.

stagedTotes.description: Totes staged for pack by sessions this call closed.

heldBy.description: Another picker's live session on the order.

reopen.description: true when the caller's open session on the order was reused.
